name: Commercial Christmas Decorators
metaDescription: Garland, wreaths, entrance décor and lobby displays for hotels, malls, banks and restaurants across Ontario and the GTA. Custom quote, one point of contact.
heroIntro: Garland, wreaths, bows and entrance décor for hotels, restaurants, banks, malls and other commercial properties, planned around your lighting.
intro: A lit roofline gets attention, but garland, wreaths, bows and a well-styled entrance are what make customers, guests and tenants actually pause and take notice. Our commercial decorating service covers exactly that, entrance displays, lobby and atrium touches, garland along railings and storefronts, and wreaths sized appropriately for a commercial entrance rather than a residential front door. We work with hotels, restaurants, banks, malls, churches, municipalities and other properties where first impressions matter during the holiday season.

Because décor is planned alongside your lighting rather than as a separate booking, the finished look is consistent from the parking lot to the entrance to the lobby. Everything is supplied, installed, maintained through the season, and removed when the holidays end, with one point of contact managing the account so you are not coordinating between multiple vendors. Multi-year and multi-location programs are available for businesses that want the same standard maintained across several sites.
included: Garland for storefronts, railings and walkways
Wreaths and bows sized for commercial entrances
Coordination with your building or roofline lighting

sections.heading: How commercial decorating works
sections.text: We start with a site visit or a review of photos and plans, the same way we approach commercial lighting, to figure out which entrances, lobbies or storefront areas get the most foot traffic and attention. From there we design garland, wreath and entrance décor that complements any lighting already planned for the property. Installation is scheduled around your business hours, with after-hours or overnight access available for retail and office properties that do not want décor crews working during customer hours.

sections.heading: How commercial decorating is priced
sections.text: Like lighting, commercial décor is custom-quoted because a single bank branch entrance and a full mall or hotel lobby require very different scopes of material and installation time. Pricing depends on the number of entrances or lobby areas being decorated, the size and quantity of wreaths and garland, whether interior atrium or lobby styling is included, and if the program covers a single property or multiple locations under one contract. We provide a firm number after the initial site visit or plan review.

sections.heading: What to expect through the season
sections.text: Once décor is installed, it is maintained through the season as part of the program, so garland does not sag and wreaths stay presentable through weeks of holiday foot traffic. For properties like hotels, restaurants and malls that see heavy use of their entrances and lobbies, that ongoing maintenance matters more than a one-time install. When the season ends, our crew handles full removal, and multi-year clients have the same design ready to reinstall the following year without redoing the planning from scratch.

pricing: Commercial decorating is always custom-quoted, based on a site visit or a review of your property's photos or plans. Cost depends on how many entrances, lobbies or storefront areas are involved, the volume of garland and wreaths needed, and whether the program covers one location or several. There is no fixed commercial rate since scope varies significantly between property types.

faq.q: Do you decorate lobbies and interiors, not just entrances?
faq.a: Yes. Beyond entrance décor like garland and wreaths, we also handle atrium and interior styling for lobbies and common areas, particularly for hotels, malls and office buildings where the interior holiday look matters just as much as what customers or guests see from the parking lot on their way in.

faq.q: Can décor be maintained through the whole season?
faq.a: Yes, season-long maintenance is part of the program so garland, bows and wreaths stay presentable through weeks of foot traffic rather than looking tired by mid-December. This matters especially for high-traffic commercial entrances and lobbies that see hundreds of visitors a day through the holidays and cannot afford a shabby-looking display.

faq.q: Do you offer programs for businesses with multiple locations?
faq.a: Yes. Multi-location programs are available with one point of contact managing decorating across several properties, so a business with multiple branches, stores or buildings can maintain a consistent standard without coordinating separate vendors and separate invoices at each individual site every holiday season, no matter how many locations are involved.

faq.q: How do you quote a decorating project without seeing the property first?
faq.a: We start with either an in-person site visit or a review of photos and plans of your property, since scope varies significantly by entrance size, number of lobby areas, and whether interior atrium styling is included. A firm quote follows once we understand the full scope of what you need decorated.
